content: Socket.IO has documented memory-leak footguns: empty rooms are not always auto-deleted on disconnect, and using adapter.clients()/allRooms() APIs (vs the standard .rooms object) can leak memory under load; perMessageDeflate can also destabilize memory under high throughput. For multi-tenant horizontal scaling, the Redis (or NATS/Mongo) adapter is the standard way to share room state across server instances.
